# Agent notes

## Commands

- Test: `TZ=UTC bun test`
- Lint: `bun run lint` (oxlint)
- Type check: `bun run typecheck` (`tsc --noEmit`)
- Build: `bun run build` (bundles `src/index.ts` into `dist/`)

## Gotchas

- Always set `TZ=UTC` when running tests. The date fixtures are written in UTC, so the date tests fail in any other timezone.
